title: Handle the other case with otherwise
objective: Add an otherwise branch that runs when no condition is true, and use one if-otherwise to choose between two paths.

body.text: An if on its own runs its lines only when the condition is true. otherwise adds the lines that run when it is false. Use it whenever there are exactly two outcomes, such as pass and fail, or found and not found.

body.title: Two outcomes
body.code:
make found equal to false
if found
    say "found"
otherwise
    say "not found"
make score equal to 40
if score is at least 50
    say "pass"
otherwise
    say "try again"

body.text: otherwise can follow an otherwise if, as the last fallback. It runs only when none of the conditions before it were true. Here, neither the first nor the second condition is true, so the fallback runs.

body.title: A final fallback
body.code:
make answer equal to 40
make expected equal to 42
make close answer equal to 40
if answer is equal to expected
    say "correct"
otherwise if answer is equal to close answer
    say "nearly"
otherwise
    say "not quite"
make light equal to false
if light is equal to true
    say "bright"
otherwise
    say "dark"

body.prompt: A score of 40 fails, but the program prints nothing at all for it. Make it print try again.
body.starter:
make score equal to 40
if score is at least 50
    say "pass"
